_comment: Casting for Nina's Toverbakkerij. Generated via the Higgsfield connector at asset-production time; the shipped app plays bundled MP3s and never calls the API. Always regenerate a character's lines with its recorded voice_id so the voice stays consistent across rooms added later.

fairy.name: De toverfee
fairy.note: Young voice, so she reads as a playmate rather than a grandmother-figure. Write her lines as someone having fun alongside Nina, not instructing her.

oven.note: Must be clearly distinct from the fairy so Nina can tell who is talking without looking.

party_guests.note: Several distinct voices. Silly beats good at this age.
